Repair the module as a LIFO stack with new, push, pop and size; empty pop returns nil. Do not change the test.

files.content:
local M = {}
function M.new() return {items = {}} end
function M.push(s, value) table.insert(s.items, value) end
function M.pop(s) return table.remove(s.items, 1) end
function M.size(s) return #s.items end
return M

local repair = require('repair')

local s = repair.new()
repair.push(s, 'a'); repair.push(s, 'b'); repair.push(s, 'c')
assert(repair.size(s) == 3)
assert(repair.pop(s) == 'c'); assert(repair.pop(s) == 'b'); assert(repair.pop(s) == 'a')
assert(repair.pop(s) == nil and repair.size(s) == 0)

print('lua repair ok')
